test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is NOT correct? (As of March 2023)

options.text: Mahendragiri is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats.
The height of the Western Ghats progressively decreases from north to south.
The Western Ghats cause orographic rain.
The Eastern Ghats stretch from the Mahanadi Valley to the Nilgiris in the south.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The height of the** Western Ghats progressively decreases from north to south.**
 
• In reality, the **Western Ghats increase in height from north to south.**
 
• **The southern portion of the Western Ghats is generally higher than its northern counterpart, with some of the highest peaks found in the states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu.**

***Hence statement 2 is incorrect.***
